title: Grammar: Asking the price: three ways, same meaning
subtitle: Unit 5: Numbers, money and prices

steps.title: Asking the price: three ways, same meaning
rows: Ça fait quatre dollars. (used for a total)

steps.title: Tip
steps.body: Learn the chunk Ça fait ... dollars for totals at the register, and Ça coûte ... for a single price. Clerks mostly say Ça fait.
